title: Earth Has a Second Moon (Sort Of)
description:
A small asteroid called Kamo'oalewa travels around the Sun in step with Earth, so from here it seems to loop around us. Its colour matches Moon rock, so it may be a chip of the Moon. China's Tianwen-2 probe is going to sample it.

Sources: NASA/JPL on 2016 HO3 (2016); Sharkey et al., Communications Earth & Environment (2021); Jiao et al., Nature Astronomy (2024); CNSA Tianwen-2 mission (launched May 2025).
Narration is AI-generated text-to-speech and the pictures are AI-generated illustrations.
